mentions.name: fless.io
mentions.description: This service turns apartment hunting into a lean-back experience by skipping the spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling work, and spammy building follow-ups, while connecting users with vetted buildings, movers, and other moving-related services. It launched in Chicago, New York, and Santa Clara with more cities added regularly; users can request a city via a form to be notified when it goes live, and can point AI agents to its ai-agents page to have the agent handle the search.
mentions.problem: Finding an apartment is a slog of spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling, and spammy follow-ups.
mentions.audience: Renters and apartment seekers in supported cities, plus people who want AI agents to handle the search
mentions.source_excerpt:
At https://fless.io we're turning the slog of finding an apartment into a lean back experience.

We help you skip the spreadsheets, endless emails, scheduling work and spammy building follow-ups while connecting you with vetted buildings, movers and other moving related services.
mentions.author: flessio

mentions.name: Fless
mentions.description: This AI agent helps users find apartments: they state what they want, and the service filters and sorts listings, reaches out to properties to confirm a unit meeting the criteria is actually available by the requested move-in date, schedules tours, coordinates the tour calendar (including Uber rides), and protects privacy from post-tour spam. It also helps review lease agreements, identify discounts to ask for, and schedule vetted movers. It recently launched skills and MCP integration so AI agents such as Perplexity, OpenClaw, Hermes, and Claude can use it, available via GitHub and PyPI.
mentions.problem: Apartment hunting normally means juggling emails, texts, and spreadsheets, and sharing contact details exposes renters to post-tour spam.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're working on an apartment hunting agent called Fless (https://fless.io).

Tell us what apartment you want.

We filter, sort and reach out to confirm apartments actually have a unit that meets your criteria by the move-in date you're looking for.
mentions.author: flessio
